Microsoft Visual C++ OpenMP Runtime Notice

SpinTexture bundles the unmodified vcomp140.dll runtime required by the
official Real-ESRGAN ncnn Vulkan Windows worker. The runtime is a Microsoft
Visual C++ Redistributable component and remains governed by Microsoft's
applicable Visual Studio and redistributable runtime license terms.

Current supported redistributable information:
https://learn.microsoft.com/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist

No Microsoft rights are granted by the SpinTexture project.
